name: Fungus-Covered Sinkhole

stealth.details: (or DC 0 if the fungus sheet covering the pit is destroyed)

disable: DC 19 Thievery check to quickly cut a few key strands of fibrous fungus to cause the whole sheet to hang free

items.name: Pitfall
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks onto the sheet of fungus

---

Effect The triggering creature falls 30 feet into area H7, taking 15 falling damage and an additional 6d6 piercing damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save save) from the many stalagmites they land on. That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling (DC 24).

text: A sheet of fungus covers a sinkhole that drops 30 down into area H7 below.
